class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackFluidSynth
class.description: AudioStreamPlaybackFluidSynth is the transient render session created by [AudioStreamFluidSynth]'s playback instantiation. It renders the stream's synth on the audio thread and owns the SMF transport ([code]fluid_player_t[/code]) for the duration of a play: [code]_start[/code] creates the player and feeds it the stream's MIDI data, while [code]_mix[/code] renders [code]fluid_synth_write_float[/code] directly. It is not instantiated from script; assign an [AudioStreamFluidSynth] to an [AudioStreamPlayerFluidSynth] node instead.
